title: validate-reply
description: POST /api/v1/licence/validate 200 reply. A licence problem is a 200 with a status, never an error code, so the till always gets the messages.

licenceToken.description: A new token to store (renewal, extension, features or seats changed, re-signed with another kid). null = keep the current one.

registers.description: One entry per register in the request. A register missing here = allowed.

apiKey.description: A replacement branch key (rotation). The till switches to it at once; keep the old key valid for 7 days.

minimumAppVersion.description: Tills below this show 'please update' (they keep trading).

nextCheckAfterSeconds.description: When to call licence/validate next (the till adds a little random jitter).

hubUrl.description: Optional (2026-09-28). Only when sync runs on another host than the address built into the till.
